turns.instruction:
The two-storey frame has 5 m and 7 m bays, floor pressure 10 kN/m2 on both floors, and left tributary width 4 m. The right tributary width is missing. Check the load conversion and request the essential missing parameter if it is not uniquely determined. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-storey rightmost beam-column joint, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at the leftmost ground-level column base for every original load case and every listed combination, with signs and units.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

The right tributary width is 6 m on both floors. Keep the pressure at 10 kN/m2 and the left width at 4 m, giving left and right downward line loads of 40 and 60 kN/m respectively. Apply the floor pressure conversion once, preserve the C1/C2 column assignments, and analyze. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-storey rightmost beam-column joint, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at the leftmost ground-level column base for every original load case and every listed combination, with signs and units.
